Pani ki supply line pichle chaar din se mukammal band hai nalke sookhe pare hain aur peene ka pani nahi hai. Hum ahl e mohalla sakht aziyat mein mubtala hain garmi ka mausam hai bachay aur buzurg pareshan hain meharbani farma kar fori pani ki supply bahal karein.

Bakhidmat janab municipal afsaran hum teen baar application jama karwa chuke hain magar koi amli peshraft nahi hui. Gutter ubal kar nala ban chuka hai aur ganda pani har taraf beh raha hai jis se badboo phail gayi hai. Baraye meharbani safai karwai jaye.
janab aali pichle teen din se hum sab pareshan hain roz marrah ke kaam ruk gaye hain aur line mein pani bilkul nahi aa raha

11kv transformer se shadeed sparking ho rahi hai aur dhamaka hua hai current ka khatra hai. Janab hum ne subah se call center par mutaddad complaints darj karwai hain lekin abhi tak koi lineman nahi aaya meharbani karke fori supply disconnect karke repair karein.

Janab aali hum ahl e mohalla aap ki tawajjo is maslay ki janib dilana chahtay hain log sakht pareshan hain. Bijli ki nangi taar toot kar zameen par gir pari hai current chal raha hai aur bachon ki aamad o raft hai. Fori team bhej kar taar hatwayen.
salam bhai bohot din se complaint kar rahe hain koi sunwai nahi ho rahi voltage bohat kam hai aur light bar bar trip kar rahi hai
Gas ki distribution line mein shadeed leak hai tez boo phail rahi hai fori emergency team bheji jaye. Hum bar bar call kar rahe hain aag lagne ka sangeen khatra hai koi sunne ko tayyar nahi.

Janab mohtaram pichlay do din se awam zillat utha rahi hai koi dekhne wala nahi hai. Ghar mein gas bilkul gayab hai chulha nahi jal raha khana pakana namumkin ho chuka hai. Baraye mehrbani supply bahal karein.
assalam o alaikum hum log subah se bhookay baithe hain gas bilkul nahi hai

Kachray ka bara dher gali ke kone par para hua hai aur kura uthane wali gari nahi aayi. Pichle do hafton se badboo aur machar barh gaye hain bimari phailne ka khatra hai barah e karam fori safai karwayen.

Janab aali hum kai martaba complaint counter par ja chuke hain magar sirf tasalliyan di ja rahi hain. Dustbin overflow ho kar kachra road par bikhra hua hai aur kuttay nooch rahe hain. Meharbani karke kachra uthwayen.
salam afsar sahab hamare mohallay mein kachra kundi ubal rahi hai safai bilkul nahi hui

Bina permit aur NOC ke commercial building par chotha illegal floor banaya ja raha hai. Hum ahl e mohalla ne pehle bhi notice bheja tha magar builder ne dubara ghair qanooni kaam shuru kar diya hai fori seal kiya jaye.

Mohtaram janab hum ahl e ilaqa aap ki tawajjo is janib mabzool karwana chahtay hain. Saath wali imarat ke pillar mein khatarnak daraar aa chuki hai aur building girne ka shadeed khatra hai. Barah e karam technical team bhej kar muaina karein.
